newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine province receives bids for gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Argentine province receives bids for gas pipeline.

text.p: Argentina's province of Buenos Aires said Wednesday the lowest bid it received for a contract to build a gas pipeline was $112.32 million compared with its budgeted cost of $105.77 million.
The lowest bid was offered by Argentine construction firms Victor Contreras, Pamar SA and C.P.C. The second lowest offer came from Contrera Hnos, Gualtieri and Jaime Cool (UTE) with $112.61 million.
The highest offer came from Argentine industrial conglomerate Techint SA which offered $115.90 million.

Because the province has to consider the full aspects of the offers including the materials to be used and other technical elements, the winner of the contract is not likely to be announced before the end of January, the province said in a statement.
